layers.message: Initial orders CLI with summary command
Promote customer totals cycle to standard

graderOnly: The standard scope (AC-001, AC-002) and the technical design describe exactly the behavior the expedited implementation already has: src/totals.js and the totals command in bin/orders.js satisfy them without any code change, so reconciling the development plan is bookkeeping only (Implementation Contract paths and AC mappings).

DEV-001 (aggregation and ordering in src/totals.js) maps naturally to AC-001 and AC-002; DEV-002 (CLI output) maps to AC-001 and, because it prints in the returned order, also supports AC-002. Any mapping that uses only AC-001 and AC-002 and covers both is acceptable.

No existing test exercises the totals command; formal verification belongs to Tester after Developer hands off. Handing off to TESTING after reconciliation, or stopping after reconciliation with the plan valid, are both acceptable outcomes.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Node ES-module CLI `orders` with a summary command, node:test suites (6 tests), sample CSV. 50-expedited-plan: first cycle started EXPEDITED at DEVELOPING; approved AUTONOMOUS plan with DEV-001/DEV-002 mapped to EXPEDITED_REQUEST, Scope/Architecture NONE in its Implementation Contract. 51-totals-command: src/totals.js and the totals subcommand; plan COMPLETE with DONE steps and self-check evidence citing the layer-50 commit. 52-promotion: user-authorized PROMOTE from DEVELOPING to STANDARD/AUDITING with PromotionReason (Tester-owned verification and documentation). 53-context: CONTEXT.md with Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work for the totals code; state SCOPING. 54-scope: scope record defining AC-001 (one line per customer with summed total, two decimals) and AC-002 (ordering, ties by name); state ARCHITECTING. 55-design: design record covering both ACs with a contract identical to the existing implementation; final STATE.md is DEVELOPING/STANDARD, recovery and obligations inactive, Scope/Architecture/Development set, Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. check.mjs is ok: the plan uses no AC IDs yet, COMPLETE plan with all steps DONE, design accounts for AC-001/AC-002.
